title: Close v1
description: Companion schema for spec/judge-record-family-v1.md section 3. The root schema validates a Close record per the Evidence Layer's reconcile model (draft-mih-agent-evidence-layer-00.md section 'Reconcile and Close'): period, counts by kind, and the head digest at close time, with an optional reconcile block. The same schema serves both a single-store period Close (reconcile absent) and capsule-emit-mesh's two-party Close (reconcile.peer_close cites the other side's Close record) -- one shape, not a parallel family. epistemic_type is fixed to producer_claim: a Close is the store's own statement about its own history, never self-certifying its own AGREED/UNILATERAL/CONTESTED status (that status is read from acknowledges/rebuts links pointing AT this record, per the owning document; reconcile.status below is a reporting convenience, not the authoritative source) The link from a two-party Close to the peer's Close is an Evidence Layer typed link (draft-mih-agent-evidence-layer-00, section 'Typed Links'; REGISTRY.md section 18), carried in the x-prefixed extension `x-evidence-links` -- NOT a Capsule `citation_purpose` (REGISTRY.md section 11) and not a `chain.relation` (section 6). The Evidence Layer draft does not yet define how its links are carried on a record outside its own header shape, so this carriage is defined in spec/judge-record-family-v1.md section 0a and is x-prefixed until a published spec registers it (ruled 2026-10-04). The earlier `reconcile.peer_close` citation (citation_purpose `reconciles_with`, an unregistered token) is removed; its released vector stays frozen at vectors/judge/close/pos-example-org-close.json.

EvidenceLinkType.description: The Evidence Layer's closed link-type vocabulary (draft-mih-agent-evidence-layer-00, section 'Typed Links'; REGISTRY.md section 18), mirrored here, never redefined. Distinct from Capsule `chain.relation` (section 6) and `citation_purpose` (section 11).

EvidenceLink.description: One Evidence Layer typed link, shaped as the draft's record-header `links` entry ({type, target}): a typed, directed reference to the target record by its digest (lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the target's JCS bytes). A link never mutates its target.

ReconcileTallies.description: The Evidence Layer's six-state reconcile vocabulary (section 'Reconcile and Close'), mirrored here, never redefined. One_only/other_only are not disagreement; only CONFLICTING is.

counts_by_kind.description: Record count by record_type over the period, e.g. {"observation": 12, "evaluation-report": 3}. Open keys -- record_type is itself an open token (Evidence Layer, section 'The Record Model').

x-evidence-links.description: Evidence Layer typed links this record carries (spec/judge-record-family-v1.md section 0a), x-prefixed until a published spec registers the carriage. When `reconcile` is present the record MUST carry exactly one `cites` link, and its `target` is the digest of the peer store's Close for the same period: the reconcile tallies are intelligible only with reference to that Close. The link is present under every reconcile.status, including UNILATERAL. A `cites` link changes no Close status: status is read only from `acknowledges` / `rebuts` links a counterparty record makes TO a Close.
